reviews.text: Too good to be true. I thought I found a genuinely great brown noise app till they demanded for money to listen to brown noise. Corporate greed at its finest.

Nope!. Updates like this are exactly why I disabled auto-updates for all my apps. I'm still on the old one. Greedy and shameless update. I won't be reading your inevitable AI-generated response to this review, thanks.
Good luck with updates. it's a great app until iPhone has an update and then it just keeps charging you even though you've already purchased it.

Absolutely zero reason to charge people money for this.. This app used to be quite useful, offering a simple way to play white, brown, green, or pink noise for any length of time. However, they recently introduced an update that requires payment after an hour of use. This change is completely stupid, as brown noise is widely available for completely free elsewhere. It seems the same sounds I can easily access for free from a fan or an AC are behind a paywall. Entirely pointless and stupid. If you value your money, do not download this app.

reviews.text: Very nice and very simple noise app. 100% absolutely love this! Thank you for being honest and very simple developer Yellowcat. One screen. 4 noise sounds to choose from. And a timer option. You can even choose 3 sound intensity for each color. I really enjoy the deep brown noise.

Wow. i love the fact that you can select the level of depth for your color. I’ve never seen that before in any of the apps that are out there on the market. This is something beyond what’s available. I love this, and I love the fact that I can either lighten the depth or deepen the depth of the color. This is incredible. It’s awesome and I love it. You guys have done a great job. What a good find and thank you for turning me to this. I couldn’t be happier. This will help so much.
Soothing. Medium brown noise on this app is so soothing -- like riding in a car, or air conditioning:-) Very deep and calming to focus on and go to sleep to.

More deep sleep. I heard about Brown Noise Machine from my oldest son about 6 months ago. I’ve slept with a fan for years, to cut out outside noise, but I’ve found that with Brown Noise Machine, also playing in the background at night, I sleep more soundly. Thank you!

An Insomniacs Hope. I’ve been an insomniac for years. This app,particularly brown noise set at medium has been so soothing, I can finally fall asleep. I can’t thank the developers enough. Thank you for a simple, free way to enhance my ability to navigate overcoming the worst of my insomnia.
No adds + easy to use. the *perfect* noise machine app. has four sounds to pick from, plays continuously with no interruptions, no purchases necessary to use.

Shocked It Worked. As someone who has had problems falling asleep for years because of raving thoughts and now tinnitus that developed in the last year, I was desperate. I never heard of brown noise until I was researching tinnitus. 

I found several apps for this sound, but they were rather expensive. I found this free app and tried it. I wasn’t expecting much but the brown noise, as opposed to white noise, was different,. it sounded like I was on an airplane, which usually puts me to sleep.

From the hour plus it normally took me to fall asleep, it takes me about 15 minutes. And it blocks my tinnitus fairly efficiently. I still hear it, but the brown noise makes it less obvious. 

I keep it on all night and though I still wake up every hour or two, I’m able to fall back to sleep
quickly.

I was thinking of trying other apps and go for the free trials, but then I thought that if this app is working why try anything else?
